preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the array N is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= A_i <= 10**5 for A_i in map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case, each element A_i in the array A is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(list(filter(lambda x: x == A_i, A))) <= 2 for A in [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)] for A_i in set(A))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the frequency of each integer in the array A is at most 2.

postconditions.expression: all(len(B) == N for N, B in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the array B is equal to the length of the array A.

postconditions.expression: all(set(A) == set(B) for A, B in zip([list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the array B contains the same elements as the array A.

postconditions.expression: all(len(list(filter(lambda x: x == A_i, A))) == len(list(filter(lambda x: x == A_i, B))) for A, B in zip([list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)]) for A_i in set(A))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the frequency of each integer in the array B is the same as in the array A.

postconditions.expression: all(len(list(filter(lambda i: A[i] != B[i], range(len(A))))) == int(input().split()[0]) for A, B in zip([list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the Hamming distance between the arrays A and B is equal to the maximum possible Hamming distance.
